aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable test context but changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not the actual test condition.
Baseline versus post-stretch/timepoint conditions are ambiguous.
Outcome stats mix dimensions, gaps, cooling time, and position incorrectly.
Spec and final decision are not incorporated.
Evidence is mostly headers and omits key data/decision rows.
correctionPlan: Define the factor as coil post-stretch condition/timepoint and related Test1/Test2 process checks.
Preserve subgroup keys: test number, AWF, cooling time, position, day/check stage.
Separate Test1 dimension/gap results from Test2 AI/hearing check results.
Cite full data rows, gap rows, spec row, and decision row if populated.
Apply the stated length/width specs and avoid treating setup fields as measurements.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove report context only; final evidence needs specific result and decision rows.
